description: This Java class defines AttributableDate, a subclass of java.util.Date that implements Attributable, designed for handling date attributes in the OpenMRS medical record system. It provides methods for parsing, formatting, and serializing dates in 'yyyy-MM-dd' format, with integration into the OpenMRS context.

classes.name: AttributableDate
classes.description: A date class extending java.util.Date, implementing Attributable, allowing date attributes to be stored and formatted in 'yyyy-MM-dd' format within the OpenMRS framework.
